The vehicle has a two-tone color scheme (beige/cream lower body, dark brown/black upper front) with red accents and text decals on the side. It features a boxy shape, large windshield, side windows, and visible wheels. There is a tripod stand in the foreground left.

Based on the number of side windows and overall dimensions, the capacity aligns with the 4-10 passenger definition of a minibus.
